raw_answers:
{
  "rules": [
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "has_security_keyword", "op": "eq", "value": true}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "in", "value": ["business", "enterprise"]}], "action": "SECURITY_INCIDENT", "note": "Security keyword for business/enterprise"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "has_security_keyword", "op": "eq", "value": true}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "SECURITY_INCIDENT", "note": "Security keyword with severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "has_security_keyword", "op": "eq", "value": true}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Security keyword default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 1}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "enterprise"}], "action": "ONCALL_ESCALATION", "note": "Severity 1 enterprise"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 1}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "business"}, {"attr": "off_hours", "op": "eq", "value": true}], "action": "ONCALL_ESCALATION", "note": "Severity 1 business off hours"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 1}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "business"}], "action": "T3_ENGINEERING", "note": "Severity 1 business"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 1}, {"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "api"}], "action": "T3_ENGINEERING", "note": "Severity 1 api"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 1}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Severity 1 default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "billing"}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "enterprise"}], "action": "ACCOUNT_MANAGER", "note": "Billing enterprise"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "billing"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "BILLING_SPECIALIST", "note": "Billing severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "billing"}, {"attr": "prior_tickets_30d", "op": "gte", "value": 3}], "action": "BILLING_SPECIALIST", "note": "Billing prior tickets >= 3"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "billing"}], "action": "SELF_SERVICE_DEFLECT", "note": "Billing default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "enterprise"}, {"attr": "prior_tickets_30d", "op": "gte", "value": 5}], "action": "ACCOUNT_MANAGER", "note": "Enterprise prior tickets >= 5"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "business"}, {"attr": "prior_tickets_30d", "op": "gte", "value": 8}], "action": "ACCOUNT_MANAGER", "note": "Business prior tickets >= 8"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "api"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "T3_ENGINEERING", "note": "Api severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "api"}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Api default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "integrations"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "T3_ENGINEERING", "note": "Integrations severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "integrations"}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Integrations default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "mobile"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 2}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Mobile severity 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "product", "op": "eq", "value": "dashboard"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Dashboard severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "language", "op": "eq", "value": "pt"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Portuguese severity <= 2"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "channel", "op": "eq", "value": "phone"}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "free"}], "action": "SELF_SERVICE_DEFLECT", "note": "Phone free"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "channel", "op": "eq", "value": "phone"}, {"attr": "off_hours", "op": "eq", "value": true}, {"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "neq", "value": "enterprise"}], "action": "T1_GENERAL", "note": "Phone off hours non-enterprise"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "free"}, {"attr": "severity", "op": "gte", "value": 3}], "action": "SELF_SERVICE_DEFLECT", "note": "Free severity >= 3"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "eq", "value": "free"}, {"attr": "prior_tickets_30d", "op": "eq", "value": 0}], "action": "SELF_SERVICE_DEFLECT", "note": "Free no prior tickets"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "eq", "value": 4}, {"attr": "prior_tickets_30d", "op": "eq", "value": 0}], "action": "SELF_SERVICE_DEFLECT", "note": "Severity 4 no prior tickets"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "lte", "value": 2}], "action": "T2_TECHNICAL", "note": "Severity <= 2 default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "customer_tier", "op": "in", "value": ["business", "enterprise"]}], "action": "T1_GENERAL", "note": "Business/enterprise default"},
    {"conditions": [{"attr": "severity", "op": "gte", "value": 1}], "action": "T1_GENERAL", "note": "Catch-all default"}
  ],
  "note": "Reglas de enrutamiento basadas en el manual de la empresa, ordenadas de más específicas a más generales, con prioridad explícita para solapamientos no contenidos."
}
